description: Exercise principal-bound history cleanup and short-profile retention expiry in an isolated release.
preconditions: The isolated release uses run-scoped observer and history-cleanup credentials and a short retention profile.
assertions: Only the history-cleanup role can preview and submit cleanup; configured intervals and active retention workers are reported; expired previews, cleanup results, and terminal projections leave their query windows; automatic full-receipt cleanup deletes eligible test data.

checks.description: Verify authentication and separate observe and history-cleanup permissions.
Verify server-defined preview categories and bounded preview responses.
Verify durable submission, retry idempotency, and conflicting request rejection.
Verify cleanup previews and operation results remain bound to their principal.
Wait for cleanup completion, then verify preview, result, projection, and receipt expiry under the short profile.

outputs: Policy version, preview IDs, operation ID and terminal cleanup counters.
